senses.gloss: नय-साहस-उन्नति + मन्त् नय-साहस-उन्नति + मन्त्, endowed (i. e. performed) with wisdom, power, and majesty, Pañc. iii. d. 264.
नय- + चक्षुस् नय- + चक्षुस्, n. the eye of prudence, Rām. 1, 7, 11.

† नय् नय्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To go.
 2. To protect.
 --Cf. नी.

नय नय, i. e. नी + अ, m.
 1. Leading, Rām. 2, 1, 21.
 2. Conduct, Hariv. 7346; way of life, Kathās. 20, 191.
 3. Prudent conduct, Bhartṛ. 2, 19.
 4. Prudence, Bhāg. P. 3, 7, 9; Daśak. in Chr. 198, 6 (read त्वन्नय एवात्र भूयान्, Thy prudence is here of greater weight).
 5. Policy, Man. 7, 159.
 6. Design, Pañc. i. d. 358.
 7. Philosophical system, Bhāṣāp. 16.
 8. Prudent conduct personified as son of Dharma by Kriyā, Mārk. P. 50, 26.
 9. A proper name, Hariv. 489.
 --Comp.
 cf. अनय.

नयन नयन, i. e. नी + अन, n.
 1. Leading, MBh. 12, 458.
 2. Ruling, 1, 2580.
 3. Leading to, Śāk. 71, 14.
 4. Bringing, Pañc. 174, 19.
 5. The eye, Rām. 1, 59, 16.
 --Comp.

नयवन्त् नय + वन्त्, adj., f. वती.
 1. Versed in policy, Rām. 5, 81, 14.
 2. Prudent, Kir. 5, 20.

नायक नायक, i. e. नी + अक,
 I. m.
 1. A guide, Rām. 2, 64, 33.
 2. A chief, Bhāg. P. 4, 7, 22.
 3. A general, Rām. 3, 33, 14.
 4. A husband, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 20.
 5. A lover, Śāk. 15, 12.
 6. The [] central gem of a necklace, Vāsav. 17, 1.
 7. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 158.
 II. f. यिका, A mistress, Lass. 24, 17.
 --Comp.
नयन- + पुट नयन- + पुट, an eyelid.
नय- + शालिन् नय- + शालिन्, adj. conversant with politics, Kir. 5, 24.
नय- + शास्त्र नय- + शास्त्र and नीति-, n. 1. the science of political conduct, Rām. 3, 56, 18; MBh. 1, 5567. 2. works on polity, Pañc. pr. d. 2.
नयन- + सलिल नयन- + सलिल, n. tears, Megh. 40; 88.
